steps.say: Cancers on the right side bleed quietly and grow large before discovery, while left-sided ones block early and cramp. Bleeding from the back passage with urgency points to the rectum. Every adult with rectal bleeding needs a finger examination and a scope.
steps.tx: Right-sided tumours present with **iron deficiency anaemia** (pale blood from slow loss) and a palpable mass, while left-sided cancers cause colicky pain with altered habit, and rectal tumours add bleeding with **tenesmus** (constant urge to pass stool) and urgency that always needs examination with endoscopy.

vis.alt: Outline of the large bowel showing a bulky right-sided mass and a narrow left-sided constriction.
vis.caption: Tumour location decides symptoms: bulky right-sided mass with anaemia against constricting left-sided apple-core with colic. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: The rectum is removed inside its fatty envelope, following a natural plane down to the pelvic floor. The nerves for bladder and sexual function run just outside that envelope and must be preserved. Margins are measured in centimetres and millimetres.
steps.tx: **Total mesorectal excision** (rectum removed in its fatty envelope) follows the holy plane with a **2 cm** (two centimetre) distal margin and a **circumferential margin** (radial clearance around tumour) above **1 mm** (one millimetre), preserving autonomic nerves for urinary and sexual function.

steps.say: Colon tumours are lifted out with their whole drape of fatty tissue and the feeding vessels tied at their origin. That packet includes all the nearby glands. A dozen or more glands must reach the pathologist for reliable staging.
steps.tx: **Complete mesocolic excision** (colon with intact mesentery) with **central vascular ligation** (vessels tied at trunk origin) harvests at least **12 nodes** (twelve glands) for accurate staging, and apical node positivity worsens prognosis and strengthens the case for adjuvant chemotherapy afterwards.

steps.say: Mid and low rectal cancers usually shrink first with combined treatment, then rest several weeks before surgery. When repeat tests show the tumour has vanished completely, some patients are watched closely instead of being operated at once.
steps.tx: Mid and low cancers take long-course chemoradiotherapy **50.4 Gy** (fifty point four gray) or short-course **25 Gy** (twenty five gray) in **5 fractions** (five sittings), then resection at **6 to 12 weeks** (six to twelve weeks), with **watch-and-wait** (close surveillance) for **complete clinical response** (no detectable residual tumour).

points: Long 50.4 Gy or short 25 Gy course
Restage at six to twelve weeks
left.title: Neoadjuvant path

steps.say: A blocked left colon in a stable patient can be opened from inside with a metal tube that springs open. That buys time to prepare the bowel and plan a single clean operation, or it serves as lasting relief when cure is impossible.
steps.tx: Obstructing left-sided cancers take a **self-expanding metallic stent** (spring-open bowel tube) as a **bridge to surgery** (planned resection later) or palliation, while right-sided obstructions and unstable patients go straight to extended resection without any stenting attempt in the emergency setting.

steps.say: Spots on the liver do not always rule out cure. When the bowel tumour causes no trouble, the liver can be tackled first or together with the bowel. Scars where spots vanished after drugs must still be removed.
steps.tx: Synchronous liver metastases with an asymptomatic primary suit **liver-first** (hepatic resection before bowel) or simultaneous resection in expert centres, and **disappearing metastases** (vanished spots after drugs) still harbour viable tumour needing resection of the original liver site to prevent regrowth.

steps.say: In a contaminated emergency the surgeon avoids joining bowel. The diseased segment comes out and the upper end is brought to the skin. Low joins made in planned surgery are protected the same way until healing is proven.
steps.tx: **Hartmann procedure** (rectal stump with end stoma) suits perforation with **faecal peritonitis** (stool soilage) and unstable patients, reversed after **3 to 6 months** (three to six months). A defunctioning **loop ileostomy** (protective small-bowel stoma) shields **low anastomosis** (join near anus) within **5 cm** (five centimetres), reversed at **8 to 12 weeks** (eight to twelve weeks).

rows: Reverse at three to six months
Reverse at eight to twelve weeks

steps.say: Some bowel cancers run in families through broken repair genes. Testing every tumour finds these families, changes the extent of surgery, and sends relatives for screening before their own cancers appear.
steps.tx: Lynch screening with **microsatellite instability** (repeat-DNA errors) or **mismatch repair** (gene proofreading) testing on every cancer guides extended colectomy, with **cascade testing** (family screening) of relatives for MLH1, MSH2, MSH6 and PMS2 carriers before their own cancers can ever appear.
